description: This file defines the ConfigProvider class for the Laminas Diactoros package, providing configuration data including dependencies and component-specific settings for the package.

classes.name: ConfigProvider
classes.description: Provides configuration settings and dependency mappings for the Laminas Diactoros package, including factory interface to factory class mappings and component-specific options.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Returns the overall configuration array for the package, combining dependencies and component configuration.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns an array mapping factory interfaces to their corresponding implementation classes, for dependency injection.

methods.name: getComponentConfig
methods.description: Returns component-specific configuration options, such as trusted proxies and headers.
